title: Coffee Story
method: Native SVG paths; cup and saucer, then drink and steam, then beans and emblem.
limitations: Original editorial illustration with deliberate flat colors. This is not a photo-to-vector claim.

notes: Cup, handle, saucer, steam, beans and leaf emblem match original SVG geometry and palette. Handle opening and exterior remain transparent; source and final comparison panels are pixel-identical.

Inspected actual offline Chromium source/drawing/final preview plus opening/middle/final on light, dark and checkerboard backgrounds. Opening is blank without added blue decoration; exterior transparency and source-colored interior areas are preserved.
Inspected decoded GIF opening, drawing and final frames: 480x360, 41 stored frames, 4800 ms including final hold. The declared #FAF1E7 GIF matte is opaque, while HTML and PNG retain exterior alpha.
Original outline colors are retained. Dark source outlines have lower contrast on dark test surfaces; the supplied light matte provides the intended presentation contrast.
